title: SOMETIMES YOU WIN, SOMETIMES YOU LOSE

content:
So today,

What touched me was..

Overflowing emotions that left me stunned,

The "never give up" attitude I am starting to learn..

Into my world so many sporty strong friends came

There was so much more to what I thought was just a game..

Although,

There is never an excuse when you lose,

Even if you lose on deuce..

But I ll still chose to say,

Sometimes you win and sometimes you lose.. 😋

Maybe, in a way, winning and losing is just a day

But what matters is the road you have traveled, a long way..

And so many people and moments that are always going to stay.. :)

On a further thought, isn't even life like that..

It gives you a few things and keeps you waiting for a few,

To keep you up and moving, it sometimes keeps the important gifts due..

This perspective makes me happy ..

It's cool.. :)

Sometimes I win and sometimes I lose..
